at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary amounts with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Reject invalid billing operations by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with a stable snake_case code such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" or "negative_amount", and put the offending value in the detail via repr().

at-0004.title: Exclude bool when validating integer inputs
at-0004.content: When validating that a value is a positive integer, check isinstance(x, bool) first because bool is a subclass of int; otherwise True would pass as quantity 1.

at-0005.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
at-0005.content: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` before comparing or doing arithmetic (as `subscriptions.current_period` does), rather than comparing raw datetimes.

at-0006.title: Compute periods with timedelta floor division
at-0006.content: Compute billing period boundaries by building `timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and using floor division `(at - start) // length` from `ensure_utc(sub.started_at)`, mirroring `subscriptions.current_period`.
